skip.startCondition: document.body.focus() after five Tab presses on an already-navigated page
skip.note:
Superseded by skipRetest. This probe began from a page whose focus was already deep in the document, so it measured a
different start condition, not a different behaviour of the Page. It is retained unchanged rather than deleted.

skipRetest.protocol: fresh document, no programmatic focus, one Tab, then Enter
skipRetest.conclusion:
The skip link is the first keyboard stop and activating it performs the fragment navigation to `#main`. The active
element remains `body` because `<main id="main">` carries no `tabindex`, which is standard browser behaviour for a
fragment target that is not focusable; the reading position moves regardless. An optional future improvement is
`tabindex="-1"` on the landmark, which would also move the focus ring. No production change was made.
